create_simfinger_instance: create a SimFinger instance with a given finger type and optional visualization enabled
append_desired_action: append a desired action with torque and position to step the simulation forward
get_observation: get the robot observation at a given time index including joint positions and velocities
reset_finger_positions: reset finger joint positions and velocities to specified values without stepping the simulation
sanitise_torques: sanitize desired motor torques by clipping to max torque and applying velocity damping
